prompt: When a rider opens the app, show available drivers within 2 km, out of a million moving drivers.
why: Index driver positions by geohash or quadtree cells so a radius search checks only nearby cells.
trap: Push connections deliver updates; finding who's nearby is an index problem.

prompt: Users search for restaurants near their current location, sorted by distance.
why: A geospatial index (PostGIS, geohash, S2) answers nearest-neighbor queries fast.
trap: A text search index can filter by tags, but distance needs a spatial index.

prompt: For each order address, find which of 20,000 delivery zone polygons it falls inside.
tells: which of 20,000 delivery zone polygons it falls inside
why: An R-tree or S2 cell index narrows the candidates before an exact point-in-polygon test.
trap: Checking all 20,000 polygons per order is a linear scan every time.

prompt: Show which friends are within 5 miles right now, as locations update every 30 seconds.
why: Bucket users by geohash cell; look up the user's cell and its neighbors.
trap: Fan-out pushes updates to friends, but deciding who is near is a spatial query.

prompt: Locations are encoded so that nearby points share a common string prefix, making "nearby" a prefix query.
why: Geohashes turn 2D proximity into string prefixes.
trap: Remember to check neighboring cells at boundaries.

prompt: Show the five closest store locations to a user's ZIP code out of 12,000 stores.
why: A spatial index answers k-nearest queries fast.
trap: A plain list scan works at 12k, but the pattern is nearest-neighbor by location.

prompt: Drivers are dense downtown and sparse in suburbs, so fixed-size grid cells are either overloaded or empty.
tells: dense downtown and sparse in suburbs
why: A quadtree splits busy cells into smaller ones, adapting to density.
trap: Sharding by city helps scale; the in-memory index still needs to adapt.

prompt: Send a push notification when a user's phone enters any of 50,000 store boundaries.
why: Index the boundaries spatially and test each location update against nearby shapes.
trap: Push sends the alert; the geo index finds the trigger.
